AI Overview
Cutle is a daily web-based spatial puzzle game where you draw a single straight line through an irregular shape to split its total area as close to a 50:50 ratio as possible. 
cutle.org
 +1
How to Play
The Goal: Click and drag your mouse (or touch and drag) from any angle completely across the shape, then release to make your cut. 
cutle.org
 +1
Scoring: The game measures the filled area on both sides of your line. A ratio between 48:52 and 52:48 counts as a win. 
cutle.org
 +1
Trophies & Ratios:
Perfect (100.0%): A precise 50.0:50.0 split (difference under 0.1 percentage points).
Gold Trophy: Rounded 50:50 without a 100% score.
Silver Trophy: 49:51 or 51:49.
Bronze Trophy: 48:52 or 52:48. 
cutle.org
Daily vs. Infinite Mode: Everyone gets the same daily shape that resets at 00:00 UTC with one official attempt, or you can switch to Infinite Mode for unlimited practice shapes. 
cutle.org
 +2
You can play it directly on Pfiffel Cutle or Cutle.org.
